message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The second Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial starts in Abu Dhabi.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The Biennial opens on 23 October 2026 in Al Ain and on 15 November 2026 in Abu Dhabi.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The Biennial is led by Artistic Director Elvira Dyangani Ose.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The theme of the exhibition is 'Home: A Glossary for a Communal Sense of Place', viewing 'home' as an evolving collective experience.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"21 artists from the UAE and other countries participate in the event.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The artworks will be presented in public and cultural locations including Mina Zayed, Saadiyat, and Al Ain.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai authorities allowed Emirati homeowners to expand villas, build second homes for relatives, and add residential annexes.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,5,6,7]},{"claim":"New rules allow reducing setbacks to 1.5 meters.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3]},{"claim":"New rules allow building a second floor covering the entire area of the first floor.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,4]},{"claim":"To build a second villa on the same plot, residents must be over 18 years old.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,5,6]},{"claim":"Consent from neighbors is required when reducing setbacks.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,10]},{"claim":"There are restrictions on the height and location of annexes.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,7,8,9]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Registration is open for ISEA2026 in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The 31st International Symposium on Electronic/Emerging Art (ISEA2026) will take place in Dubai from 6 to 15 November 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The theme of ISEA2026 is 'ELYAH: Constellating Place, Data and Identity'.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The event will bring together artists, researchers, and innovators from around the world to discuss the intersection of art, science, and technology.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Registration for the artistic programme is free.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Access to the online academic programme requires a paid ticket with a student discount available.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,5]},{"claim":"Details and registration are available at isea2026.eventshub.ai.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Najah 2026 expands and will be held for the first time in Al Ain.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,2,8]},{"claim":"Najah is the largest higher education fair in the Middle East and will celebrate its 20th anniversary in 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Najah Al Ain will take place on 2 and 3 November at ADNEC Centre Al Ain.","supported":true,"evidence":[8]},{"claim":"Najah Abu Dhabi will be held from 18 to 21 October.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"Najah Dubai will be held from 25 to 27 October.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"The event will gather more than 100 universities from 20 countries.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Najah Al Ain will bring together more than 50 local and international universities.","supported":true,"evidence":[8]},{"claim":"Universities from the USA, Canada, UK, Germany and other countries will participate in Najah Al Ain.","supported":true,"evidence":[9]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, the first commercial vertiport VDX has been opened.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The first purpose-built commercial vertiport VDX for electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft has been completed in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The vertiport is located near Dubai International Airport.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The vertiport is designed to handle up to 170,000 passengers per year.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Schneider Electric provided the energy and digital infrastructure for the vertiport, including high-voltage systems, building management, and power quality monitoring.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"This infrastructure will optimize energy consumption and maintain flight safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"The project supports Dubai's 2040 Urban Master Plan.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"The project will reduce travel time across the city from 45 to 12 minutes.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}
